description: Per-claim queryable record promoted from claims.json (N records per file; synthetic enumeration in query-records C5). PUBLISHED READ CONTRACT: docs/research/*.claims.json is consumed read-only by external sibling repos pinning x-schema-version; field removals and semantic changes require a major bump plus a cross-repo memo to declared consumers.

id.description: Unique identifier for this claim within its claims.json file.

claim_text.description: The full text of the claim as emitted by the specialist producer.

confidence.description: Producer-assessed confidence level for this claim.

source_url.description: URL of the primary source supporting this claim.

source_date.description: Publication or retrieval date of the source (YYYY-MM-DD).

topic_tags.description: List of topic tags assigned by the producer to categorise this claim.

type.description: Semantic type of the claim as classified by the producer.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence quoted or summarised by the producer (optional).

counter_evidence.description: Counter-evidence or caveats noted by the producer (optional).

corroborated_by.description: Reference to another source or claim that corroborates this one (optional).

contested_by.description: Reference to a source or claim that contests this one (optional).
